note: Run with the skill-creator skill: each case once with the current skill and once with a snapshot or no skill. Outputs and grading go to skills/buildnotes-workspace/ (ignored).

evals.name: build-story-hono-error-middleware
evals.prompt: Write up how we built routable error and not-found middleware in Hono (PR #5541) — why we went with routing-based onError()/notFound() over the alternatives.
evals.expected_output: Build story that shows the before (old error/notFound handling) then the after, names the decision and the alternative that lost, plain headings.
assertions: Post HTML file exists in outputs
The old handling (before) appears earlier in the post than the new handling (after), and is labelled as the before
Names the chosen design and at least one alternative from #5229 that lost, with a reason taken from the record
Every chapter heading is a plain phrase readable on first pass (no imperative riddles or code names)
Title does not contain the product name 'Hono'
No clock times or PR-by-PR narration in the body
Any code block matches code in the repo at the merge commit and is <=15 lines
Hand-off lists at most three open questions

evals.name: release-story-uv-publish-prompts
evals.prompt: Short launch-style post for uv users about PR #22593: uv publish no longer prompts for credentials when env vars or keyring can already authenticate.
evals.expected_output: Short release story or note: leads with what users no longer have to do, no edge-case inventory, brief.
assertions: Output exists (post HTML or a hand-off proposing a note/rollup)
Headline says what users get (no unnecessary prompt), not the internal mechanism
Title does not contain the product name 'uv'
Body (if a post) is under 600 words
Does not enumerate edge cases or every credential source beyond what a user needs
Considers nearby related work (other publish/auth changes) — either rolls it in or mentions it in the hand-off
No PR numbers, review quotes or clock times in the body

evals.name: thin-subject-hono-gridgap
evals.prompt: Write a blog post about the gridGap px fix we made in hono/jsx (PR #5487).
evals.expected_output: Declines a full post; says briefly why; proposes a bigger arc from nearby JSX/v5 work or a changelog line; asks before proceeding.
assertions: Does not produce a full multi-section post about the gridGap fix alone
Hand-off says briefly why the fix alone is not worth a post
Hand-off names a bigger idea from nearby work, or offers a changelog line / short note
Hand-off asks the author whether to proceed with the alternative

evals.name: standard-practice-hono-serve-static
evals.prompt: Technical deep dive on why Hono's serve-static middleware now only serves GET and HEAD requests (PR #5514).
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is standard practice; declines the deep dive or offers a line in a larger release / a rollup, asks before proceeding.
assertions: Does not produce a multi-chapter deep dive about serve-static method handling alone
Hand-off says this is standard/expected behaviour that readers already understand
Offers an alternative: a line in a larger release, a rollup of related v5 changes, or a short note
Hand-off asks the author before writing the alternative

evals.name: widen-scope-uv-safeurl
evals.prompt: Write a post about uv PR #22619, which implements RemoteSource for SafeUrl.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes #22619 is one step in the SafeUrl series merged the same day and writes the series story without asking first, noting the widened scope in one sentence of the hand-off.
assertions: Writes a post (post HTML exists) rather than stopping to ask
The post's subject is the SafeUrl / URL-safety series, not RemoteSource alone
Hand-off says in about a sentence that the scope was widened and why
Hand-off does not ask permission to widen the scope
